levels.title: Sujood
levels.goal: Prostrate with the correct posture and words

steps.title: Go into Sujood
steps.detail: Forehead, nose, both palms, knees and toes touch the ground
steps.dua_translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High

data.hadith: The closest a servant comes to his Lord is when he is in sujood, so increase your supplication then.

data.meaning: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High
data.context: Say it three times in every sujood

tips: Sujood is the position of ultimate humility before Allah
This is the best time to make personal dua, even in your own words
Seven body parts touch the ground: forehead+nose, two hands, two knees, toes

questions.question: How many body parts touch the ground in sujood?

levels.title: Completing Rakat One
levels.goal: Finish the first rakat and rise for the second

lessons.title: Sit, Prostrate, Rise
lessons.description: The rest of your first rakat

steps.title: Sit up (Jalsa)
steps.detail: Sit briefly between the two prostrations

steps.title: Second Sujood
steps.detail: Go down into sujood again, saying the same tasbih

steps.title: Stand for Rakat Two
steps.detail: Rise back to standing to begin the second rakat

tips: One rakat = qiyam, ruku, two sujood with a sit in between
After the second sujood, you either stand again or sit for Tashahhud
Every rakat follows this same rhythm

data.instruction: Match each position to when it happens

data.question: Which part of the rakat feels most peaceful to you?

levels.title: Qa'dah & Tashahhud
levels.goal: Sit for Tashahhud and recite the testimony of faith

steps.title: Sit for Tashahhud
steps.detail: Left foot flat, right foot upright, index finger raised in testimony

data.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلّٰهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللّٰهِ الصَّالِحِينَ
data.meaning: All greetings, prayers, and good deeds are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah.
data.context: Recited sitting, after every two rakat

data.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
data.meaning: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger
data.context: The testimony of faith, completing the Tashahhud

tips: Tashahhud is recited every time you sit during salah
Raise your index finger when you say 'لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰه'
Take your time — this is a moment of direct testimony

questions.audio: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰه
options: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰه

levels.title: Durood & Salam
levels.goal: Send blessings on the Prophet and close your salah

lessons.title: Durood Ibrahim
lessons.description: Sending blessings on the Prophet ﷺ

data.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
data.meaning: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and his family. You are indeed praiseworthy and glorious.
data.context: Recited after Tashahhud, in the final sitting

lessons.title: Turn and Close
lessons.description: The Salam that ends your salah

steps.title: Turn right — Salam
steps.detail: Turn your head to the right
steps.dua_translation: Peace and mercy of Allah be upon you

steps.title: Turn left — Salam
steps.detail: Turn your head to the left, saying the same words

tips: Salam ends your salah — you're now free to speak
Turn far enough that others can see your cheek
This closes your conversation with Allah, in peace
